note: Editorial shortlist. No live prices by design; check Amazon.co.uk.

products.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone AF400UK
products.buy_it_if: You cook for 3 to 5 people, or you want a main and a side ready together without juggling one basket.
products.skip_it_if: You're one or two people in a small kitchen. It's big, and you'd rarely use the second drawer.

products.name: Cosori Lite 3.8L
products.buy_it_if: You're one or two people, you want it to disappear into a cupboard, and you mostly reheat or cook for one.
products.skip_it_if: You ever cook for more than two. A 3.8L basket does not do a family roast or a full tray of chips.

products.name: Tower Vortx 4L
products.buy_it_if: You want to try an air fryer without spending much, cooking for one or two.
products.skip_it_if: You already know you'll use it daily for a family. You'll outgrow 4L fast and buy twice.

products.name: Tefal Easy Fry Dual
products.buy_it_if: You want two drawers for a family but don't want to pay the Ninja premium.
products.skip_it_if: You want the smoothest two-things-done-together experience. The Ninja's sync is still the one to beat.

products.name: Instant Vortex Plus 6L
products.buy_it_if: You cook for 3 to 4 but prefer one large basket you can see into, rather than two separate drawers.
products.skip_it_if: You specifically want two foods at two temperatures at once. One basket means one setting.

products.name: Philips Airfryer 3000 Series
products.buy_it_if: You want one that still feels solid in five years, cooking for one or two, and you'll pay for it.
products.skip_it_if: You're on a budget or feeding a family. You're paying for the badge and the build, not the size.

products.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute
products.key_spec: Up to ~60 min runtime · laser dust detection
products.buy_it_if: You want the deepest clean, you have pets or allergies, you've a mix of hard floors and carpet, and the price doesn't scare you.
products.skip_it_if: You're on a budget or in a small flat. You'd be paying for power and tech you won't fully use.

products.name: Dyson V8
products.buy_it_if: You want a Dyson that's light and reliable without the flagship price, in a flat or small-to-medium house.
products.skip_it_if: You have a big house with lots of carpet. The runtime and bin are on the smaller side.

products.name: Shark Stratos Anti Hair Wrap Cordless
products.buy_it_if: You have long hair or pets and hate unpicking the brush roll. Two batteries cover a whole house in one go.
products.skip_it_if: You want the absolute lightest machine. Shark sticks are a touch heavier than a Dyson V8.

products.name: Vax ONEPWR Blade 4
products.key_spec: Up to ~45 min runtime · removable battery
products.buy_it_if: You want solid cordless cleaning without Dyson money, and you like that the battery lifts out to swap or replace.
products.skip_it_if: You want the lightest or the plushest. This is sensible and sturdy, not fancy.

products.name: Tineco Pure One S15
products.buy_it_if: You want smart features, auto suction and a dirt sensor, at a mid price rather than a flagship one.
products.skip_it_if: You distrust gadgets and just want raw simplicity. The smarts add a little cost.

products.name: Halo Capsule X
products.buy_it_if: Weight is your priority: lots of stairs, reaching up high, or limited grip strength.
products.skip_it_if: You need long runtime and big-house power. Light means a smaller battery and bin.

products.name: eufy X10 Pro Omni
products.buy_it_if: You want the hands-off life (it empties itself and washes its own mop) without paying flagship money.
products.skip_it_if: You have very thick carpet and want the absolute strongest suction; the flagships pull harder.

products.name: Roborock Saros 20
products.buy_it_if: You want the best clean money can buy: strong suction for carpet, a mop that washes itself, and a base that empties for weeks.
products.skip_it_if: You're on a budget. This is flagship money for features you may not fully use.

products.name: Dreame L10s Ultra Gen 3
products.key_spec: Self-washing mop · auto-empty base · strong suction
products.buy_it_if: You want the full hands-off experience (self-empty + self-washing mop) and strong suction, but not flagship prices.
products.skip_it_if: You want the very newest navigation tech; it's a step behind the latest flagships, which is why it costs less.

products.name: Shark Matrix Plus
products.buy_it_if: You want a well-known UK brand, good carpet and pet-hair handling, and tidy edge cleaning, at a mid price.
products.skip_it_if: You want a self-emptying base; this charges itself, but you still empty the bin yourself.

products.name: eufy L60
products.buy_it_if: You want a solid everyday robot for hard floors and pet hair without paying for a fancy station.
products.skip_it_if: You want a self-emptying base or serious mopping; this is the simple, affordable pick.

products.name: iRobot Roomba 115 Combo
products.buy_it_if: You want the reassurance of the Roomba brand plus a base that empties itself, at a budget price.
products.skip_it_if: You want top-tier mopping; it vacuums and mops, but the mop is basic next to the premium all-in-ones.

products.name: Pro Breeze 20L OmniDry
products.buy_it_if: You want one dependable unit for a normal heated home that handles damp, condensation and the odd load of washing.
products.skip_it_if: Your problem room is a cold garage or conservatory; in the cold a desiccant works better.

products.name: Pro Breeze 30L Smart
products.buy_it_if: You've got a large home, a persistent damp problem, or you're drying a building out; you need the biggest pull.
products.skip_it_if: You only need to keep one room's condensation down; this is more capacity (and size) than you need.

products.name: Pro Breeze 12L
products.buy_it_if: You want to kill condensation and damp in a single room or a small flat without spending a lot.
products.skip_it_if: You need to cover a whole house or a very damp space; the bigger units pull far more.

products.name: De'Longhi Tasciugo AriaDry Multi
products.buy_it_if: Drying laundry indoors is a main reason you're buying, and you want a known brand you can trust.
products.skip_it_if: You want the cheapest route, or a near-silent bedroom unit; it's pricier and not the quietest.

products.name: EcoAir DD1 Classic MK6
products.buy_it_if: Your damp problem is a cold or unheated space (garage, conservatory, caravan) where a normal dehumidifier struggles.
products.skip_it_if: You're drying out a big warm house; a higher-capacity compressor pulls more water per hour there.

products.name: Meaco DD8L
products.buy_it_if: You want to dry washing fast in an unheated room, or tackle damp somewhere cold, from a brand critics rate.
products.skip_it_if: Your home is warm and you want maximum water pulled per hour; a compressor does that for less.
